title: PM Modi's 80th Independence Day address — key announcements
summary: On India's 80th Independence Day, PM Modi unveiled a "Sapt Dhara" growth vision alongside a major nuclear-power push and a nationwide AI-skilling drive.

blocks.content: On India's 80th Independence Day, PM Modi unveiled a "Sapt Dhara" growth vision alongside a major nuclear-power push and a nationwide AI-skilling drive.

items: **Nuclear power**: reaffirmed **100 GW by 2047** target; 5 new reactors to be operationalised this decade (target restated 3× this month — see ANUGYAN and Nuclear Ecosystem items in Section 6; consolidated as one fact)
**AI-skilling**: 1 crore youth to receive AI-skilling training over the next year
Focus on critical minerals for tech self-reliance; plan for free coaching centres for competitive-exam aspirants
**Sapt Dhara — 7 pillars**: Manufacturing Power · Agriculture & Food Processing · Technology & Innovation · Gati Shakti · Defence Shakti · Green & Blue Economy · Soft Power
Plans for a "vibrant Civil Defence network" + modern volunteer force (existing statutory base: Civil Defence Corps under Civil Defence Act, 1968)
